description: This file defines the 'ApiParameterError' class used to model error details related to API parameters, including error messages, parameter names, values, and argument arguments. It provides static factory methods for creating standardized error instances.

classes.name: ApiParameterError
classes.description: Represents errors related to API parameters, including messages, parameter name, value, and additional arguments for error details.

methods.name: generalError
methods.description: Creates a general API parameter error with a globalisation message code, user message, and optional message arguments.

methods.name: resourceIdentifierNotFound
methods.description: Creates an error indicating that a resource identifier (e.g., 'id') was not found.

methods.name: parameterError
methods.description: Creates a parameter error with specific globalisation code, user message, parameter name, and message arguments.

methods.name: parameterErrorWithValue
methods.description: Creates a parameter error with specific value information.
